resolutions.answer: k = 4. Lower bound: the triangle {v1,v2,v3} (edges v1v2, v1v3, v2v3) and the vertex-disjoint 4-cycle v4-v5-v7-v6 (edges v4v5, v5v7, v6v7, v4v6) each require at least 2 cover vertices, so every vertex cover has size >= 2+2 = 4; in particular no cover of size 3 exists. Upper bound: {v2,v3,v4,v7} covers all nine listed edges. Method stated per E-A; derived solely from package/artifacts/graph.json.

The complete first enumeration (E-A) of all minimum-size (k=4) vertex covers, each as a sorted vertex list, list sorted: [[v1,v2,v5,v6], [v1,v3,v4,v7], [v2,v3,v4,v7], [v2,v3,v5,v6]]. Method: structured exhaustive search over all C(7,4)=35 size-4 subsets — every size-4 cover must take exactly 2 vertices from the triangle {v1,v2,v3} and exactly 2 from the 4-cycle {v4,v5,v6,v7}; all 3 triangle pairs cover the triangle, only the opposite pairs {v4,v7} and {v5,v6} cover the 4-cycle, and checking the cross edges (v2,v4) and (v3,v5) over all 6 combinations eliminates {v1,v2}+{v4,v7} and {v1,v3}+{v5,v6}; the surviving four sets were each re-verified against all nine edges.
